status: DRAFT - curves are ESTIMATED unless a field says otherwise; calibrate against OEM charts (Cat Performance Handbook / Komatsu spec sheets) and site GPS before use for planning commitments
provenance_note: data_quality: oem = OEM or OEM-dealer spec sheet/page, but captured from web-search extracts in a session where direct PDF download was blocked (values not yet checked against the PDF page); oem_derived = arithmetic on OEM values; third_party = spec aggregator / dealer listing / hire company; estimated = derived by the documented method. No rimpull or retarder chart was digitised: every curve here is a model output.

conventions.rimpull_points: [speed_kmh, rimpull_kN] - available tractive force at the rim, before traction limits, at sea level
conventions.retarder_points: [speed_kmh, retard_kN] - continuous (grade length unlimited) retarding force at the rim
conventions.interpolation: interpolate between points in power space (P = F*v linear in v, then F = P/v); clamp outside range
conventions.effective_grade: grade% + rolling_resistance% (uphill); grade% - rolling_resistance% (downhill, negative = retarding)
conventions.estimated_flags: true = derived by method in estimation_method / md section G; false = read from the cited source

rimpull.basis: loaded or empty (force is mass-independent); sea level; 32-35 C ambient; no traction limit applied
rimpull.stall_rimpull_source: OEM (older 789C spec sheet: rimpull at stall 785 kN)
rimpull.envelope_note: max over gears sampled at fixed speeds; use per-gear curves for gear-aware solving

retarder.power_source: ESTIMATED: continuous retarding power = 1.4 x gross power (Komatsu published ratios: HD785-7 1.22, HD465-7 ~1.4 assuming ~551 kW gross, HD1500-8 1.49); Cat publishes charts only
retarder.descent_speed_rule_note: discrete_gear = Cat ARC holds engine speed in the highest gear the brakes can sustain (descent speed = that gear max); continuous = Komatsu ARSC / electric drives hold an operator-set speed up to P_ret/F

trucks.estimation_method: Mechanical: rimpull_g(v) = eta*P_net*p(n/n_rated)/v with n/n_rated = v/v_max_g, p() = power fraction from a linear torque-rise model (TR=0.15, peak torque at 0.74 n_rated); 1st gear converter region blended concavely from stall rimpull to the lock-up point at 0.70 v_max_1; governor cut-off at v_max_g. Retarder: F = P_ret/v across each gear band.
